04 A WORK IN PROGRESS

Curiosity,
compiled.

I’m Manthan, an Electronics & Communication Engineering student at IIIT Pune, drawn to the beautifully precise world of digital hardware.

From a simple logic gate to a pipelined processor, I like understanding how things work — and then building them myself. My current focus spans RTL design, functional verification, processor architecture, and the protocols that connect it all.
